name: imdisk
description: Install ImDisk virtual disk driver, build a sparse 32 GB NTFS index image (C:\MAST\Shared\MAST-32GB-indexes-5202+5203.img) from the staged mast-indexes seed if it is not already present (the build mounts it file-backed to write the seed), then mount it as D: RAM-backed and VOLATILE (imdisk -a -m D: -t vm -f <image>) and register a boot-time task that re-mounts it the same way each boot. -t vm loads the index seed into RAM (fast solving) while runtime scratch writes are wiped on reboot; it commits ~32 GB RAM. The image is sparse: 32 GB logical, only ~10 GB of index files allocated on disk. Ordered before astrometry (500) so D:\mast-indexes is reachable during astrometry's smoke solve. Asserts the machine has the fleet's required RAM (-MinMemoryGB, injected by build-mast) before attempting a -t vm mount, so an under-specced unit fails with the reason rather than with 'imdisk exited 3'. Installs the declared index set (server/data/assets.json, staged as mast-indexes.json) as C:\MAST\state\mast-indexes.json and keeps D:\mast-indexes identical to it by name and size: a D: that differs is remounted, then rebuilt from the seed, which is checked first (#254).
